dashboard.title: आपका सारांश
dashboard.description: आने वाली विज़िट, जिन बातों पर आपका ध्यान चाहिए, और त्वरित लिंक।

upcoming.title: आने वाली बुकिंग
upcoming.emptyBody: जब आप किसी सत्यापित प्रदाता को बुक करेंगे, विज़िट यहाँ दिखेगी।
upcoming.more: अगली {count} बुकिंग दिखाई जा रही हैं।

profile.title: अपनी प्रोफ़ाइल पूरी करें
profile.body: बुक करने से पहले प्रदाताओं को यह जानकारी चाहिए। स्वास्थ्य जानकारी तब तक 'आपके द्वारा दर्ज' के रूप में चिह्नित रहती है जब तक कोई डॉक्टर उसकी पुष्टि न करे।
profile.unknown: हम अभी आपकी प्रोफ़ाइल जाँच नहीं सके। आप इसे फिर भी खोल सकते हैं।

actions.title: त्वरित कार्य
actions.findDoctorHint: आपके क्षेत्र में आने वाले सत्यापित डॉक्टर
actions.emergencyHint: 112 पर कॉल करें। SureCure Visit आपातकालीन सहायता नहीं भेजता।

state.denied: आपको इन बुकिंग तक पहुँच नहीं है।

bookings.title: Your bookings
bookings.description: Every visit you have requested, with booking, payment and record status shown separately.

filter.label: Filter bookings
filter.scope: Filters sort the bookings on this page. Use Next page to see more.

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.body: When you request a visit, it appears here with its status.
empty.filterTitle: No bookings under {filter} on this page
empty.filterBody: Other bookings on this page are under a different filter.
empty.endBody: You have reached the end of your bookings.

state.denied: You do not have access to these bookings.

state.notFound: This booking is not available. It may not exist, or it is not on your account.
state.gated: Booking details are not connected yet.

status.title: Status
status.body: Booking, visit, payment and clinical record are tracked separately. One does not imply another.

decision.label: Provider decision
decision.readOnly: Only the provider can accept or decline.

visit.title: Visit
visit.providerUnavailable: Provider details are not available right now.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.unavailable: The timeline is not available right now.

fee.title: Fee
fee.snapshot: Price fixed by the provider when you booked. It does not change later.

payment.unavailable: Payment details are not available right now.
payment.separate: Payment is tracked separately from the booking.

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.body: You can cancel while the provider has not started the visit.
cancel.policyBody: The provider has accepted. The cancellation policy you agreed to decides if you can still cancel.
cancel.serverDecides: We send your request and the booking system checks it. It may say no if the booking has changed.
cancel.closed: This booking can no longer be cancelled here.
cancel.confirmBody: The provider will be told. To visit later you will need to book again.
cancel.ack: I understand this cannot be undone.
cancel.doneBody: The booking status will update shortly.

reschedule.title: Reschedule
reschedule.closed: This booking can no longer be rescheduled.
reschedule.gateBody: You can pick a time, but the request cannot be sent until rescheduling is connected. To change the time now, cancel and book again.
reschedule.notSentBody: Rescheduling is not connected yet. Your booking has not changed.

error.past: Choose a time in the future.
